title: Frontend's error messages for the exit questions say "the" where Design release 1 says "a", and name the field again in the exit-date message.

finding.frontend: Submitting the destination-country page empty puts "Select the destination country" in the error summary and against the select, and the port-of-exit page puts "Select the port of exit" — both are in the captured error screens, in the summary list and repeated as the field's error message. The exit-date page's only message is "Enter a real exit date", which repeats the field name that is already the page heading and the label. The three strings live in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/destination-country/copy/copy.en.js:9, src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/port-of-exit/copy/copy.en.js:9 and src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/exit-date/copy/copy.en.js:8.
finding.prototype: Design release 1 writes the same three messages with the indefinite article and without repeating the field name: "Select a destination country", "Select a port of exit" and, when the box holds something it cannot read as a date, "Enter a real date" (app/routes.js:1398, :1407, :1426).
finding.difference: Change three strings to Design release 1's wording — "Select a destination country", "Select a port of exit" and "Enter a real date" — in the three copy files named above, and in the Welsh files beside them. Nothing has to land first. Sequence this with import-reason--purpose-and-exit-date-can-be-skipped, which adds two more messages to the same files, and with import-reason--exit-questions-split-onto-separate-pages, which decides which page these messages eventually appear on; the wording is the same either way.
finding.falsifiedBy: "Select a destination country" or "Select a port of exit" appearing in Frontend's captured error DOM. fe-destination-country-error renders "Select the destination country" and fe-port-of-exit-error renders "Select the port of exit", each twice — once in the error summary link and once in the field's error message.
finding.verification: Written and checked by the verifier, not by the slice's author, so a reader knows this one had no independent second pass. Read capture/html/frontend/fe-destination-country-error.html:116-146 and fe-port-of-exit-error.html:116-146 and ran the falsifier against both: each renders the definite article in the summary link and in the govuk-error-message, and neither contains the Design release 1 wording. Read the three frontend copy files at the cited lines and grepped the whole of app/routes.js for each message string, which returns the Design release 1 wording only inside validateImportReasonProceed. Checked that Design release 1's messages are the root mount's — validateImportReasonProceed is defined once on the single shared router and no release subfolder overrides it. Confidence is medium because Design release 1 has no captured error state for reason-for-import, so its half rests on source at the cited lines; the frontend half is observed in the two captured error screens. Checked the exit-date message against the volatile-values list: the wording is stable and the worked-example date inside the field's hint is a separate matter, already handled by import-reason--exit-questions-split-onto-separate-pages.

relatedTo.why: That finding adds two new error messages to the same copy files these three live in.
